2.Features
low power consumption
High transmission speed
Flip standard CMOS logic level
High bandwidth, high linearity
Switch for NTSC / PAL video, audio, SPDIF
and HDTV
It can be used for clock switch and data
selection switch
SN74LVC1G3157 is an analog switch based on CMOS technology.It has low power consumption, low transmission 
delay and low output impedance. The voltage output range of analog signal and digital signal can be from VCC or 
GND.The select input terminal has over-voltage protection, which allows the input voltage to be higher than VCC, 
up to 7V, and the pin will not be burned.
